Order 
This is repeat (fourth) application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. (new Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.35/2023 registered at Police Station Khargapur, District Tikamgarh (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Earlier application filed by applicant was dismissed as withdrawn.
3. Learned senior counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 02.03.2024.
Investigation is complete and charge- sheet has been filed.
It is further submitted that applicant is ready to deposit the defalcated amount as FDR before the trial Court which may be subject to final judgement passed by trial Court.
It is further submitted that applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55490 2 MCRC-47289-2024 will not threaten the complainant or witnesses of the case and will regularly attend the trial.
It is submitted that offences are not very serious in nature.
It is also submitted that complainant has been examined in Court, who is material witness.
In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned Government Advocate appearing for State as well as counsel appearing for objector opposed the application.
Counsel appearing for objector submitted that some other material witnesses are yet to be examined in Court.
Applicant may influence said witnesses.
It is submitted that applicant is having criminal track records with 18 cases.
Earlier proceedings of externment was also undertaken against the applicant and he was externed from the district.

In these circumstances,
applicant may not be released on bail.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties.
6.
Offences are said to have been committed under Sections 420, 468 and 471 of IPC which is punishable up to seven years of imprisonment.
Offence under Section 467 of IPC is punishable up to life imprisonment.
7. Considering the fact that applicant is ready to deposit the entire defalcated amount as an FDR before the trial Court and he is in jail since 02.03.2024.
Investigation is complete and one of the material witness has also been examined.

In these circumstances, bail application filed by applicant is allowed with following conditions :-
(i) Applicant will deposit the entire defalcated amount in form of FDR NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55490 3 MCRC-47289-2024 before the trial Court with instructions to bank to renew the same periodically till completion of trial.
Said FDR shall be subject to final judgment which will be passed in the case.
(ii) Applicant will mark his presence before local police station twice every month till completion of trial.
(iii) Applicant will not involve himself in any other offence in future.
(iv) If applicant is found involved in any other offence in future, then prosecution will be at liberty to file an application for cancellation of bail.
(v) Applicant will not threaten the witnesses of the case or will influence them by approaching himself or through his agent.
(vi) No unnecessary adjournment shall be taken by applicant before trial Court.
(vii) Trial Court shall conclude the trial expeditiously and may not give unnecessary adjournment to applicant.

8. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on aforesaid conditions on furnishing personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
